items.title: Presence of an alert is not recognition
items.whyItMatters: Alerts can be displayed yet unread (claim c2); counting alerts would overstate success.
items.opportunity: Make documented recognition before airway management the primary outcome.

items.title: Concurrent airway initiatives
items.whyItMatters: Other changes started around March 2023, as in the retrieved before-after study.
items.opportunity: List co-interventions with dates and use a segmented time series with enough points on each side.

items.title: Database misses events
items.whyItMatters: About a quarter of qualifying events may be missing (claim c4).
items.opportunity: Report capture against a manual sample and restrict follow-up to this hospital.

items.title: Patients least aware of their status
items.whyItMatters: Older patients, patients with limited English and emergency patients know least about their airway status.
items.opportunity: Report recognition by age, language and emergency status.

items.title: Untraced national figure
items.whyItMatters: The quoted one-third figure matches only an unverified model lead with an identifier nobody has checked.
items.opportunity: Do not cite it unless an identity check succeeds.

errorsFound: A discovery lead labelled 'landmark' carries an identifier that has not been checked; the label is not verification.
An appraisal annotation used an identifier that does not exist in the study and was dropped.
reevaluation: The study should measure recognition before airway management in a segmented time series from the database and anaesthetic records, report database capture and co-interventions, and leave the untraced national figure out.
summary: Five gaps; presence versus recognition and concurrent initiatives are high severity.
